title: lexindex: compact, immutable string-to-id indexes for huge catalogs
description:
Compact, immutable string-to-id indexes for huge catalogs, with a Rust core and Python bindings. Three complementary build-once / query-many structures: an ordered FST-backed index with prefix, range, fuzzy (Levenshtein) and subsequence queries; a minimal-perfect-hash dictionary with verified membership and reverse lookup; and a fingerprint-based minimal-perfect-hash map storing no keys at all (~1.3 bytes/key on real dictionary words). All serialise to flat, memory-mappable blobs.

Distributed on PyPI (pip install lexindex) and crates.io (cargo add lexindex); documentation at ilgrad.github.io/lexindex.
